exposure: Intrathecal anesthesia without maternal oxygen inhalation
Intrathecal anesthesia with maternal oxygen inhalation
finding: This study defined the reference interval for cerebral oxygenation saturation (cSO2) in neonates without medical support for up to one hour after birth, finding that cSO2 generally stabilizes between 7 and 8 minutes after birth and that the rate of low cSO2 was higher in babies born to mothers who did not receive oxygen during cesarean section.
mod_finding: This study examined cerebral tissue oxygenation saturation (cSO(2)) in neonates delivered by cesarean section and found that cSO(2) levels increased from about 49.0% in the second minute after birth and stabilized at 55.7-81.0% between 7 and 8 minutes after birth.
